# Core Operations: grants, shares и видимый activity feed

Source: [JSON](../../../phases/P3/P3.4.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Status

done

## Summary

Access/Share/Activity Operations авторизуют единым guard, child references scoped к узлу, activity пагинируется по реальной видимости; token возвращается один раз. HTTP и Filament consumers переведены без смены URL/JSON.

## Why

Root View сейчас открывает весь activity drive feed; foreign grant/share arguments, Manage explain и raw token protection требуют enforcement именно public boundary.

## Guidance

GrantInput rename and signatures switched with controllers/requests/fakes in this item. Core Operations need an already built context, avoiding dependency on drive package factory; final handle constructs them in P3.3. Activity cursor include query scope/drive+tenant/filter and stable tuple, actor changes force current ACL re-evaluation; never use root permission as sole feed filter. Reuse ExactListing scan pattern but return declared CursorPaginator, not NodePage/Collection; CursorPaginator built from last SCANNED activity tuple. Input cursor decode validates query identity; no total returned. Explain user-specified subject only after caller Manage. Replay share credentials/time checks not bypassed by actor system. Public tests inspect logs/activity exception payloads for exact raw token absence. Guards tested from real HTTP and Filament mutation methods with reader and foreign child references. Конкретный algorithm/query-scoped Cursor+last-scanned subclass определён в P3-design#ReadAlgorithms; native visible-item cursor не используется.

## Поставка и проверяемый scope

Concrete core Operations/{Access,Share,Activity}Operations constructor(OperationContext $context, …) implements P3.2 interfaces. NodeLocator active/trashed mode defined by operation; grants/list require View+Share, explain View+Manage (subject identity не подменяет caller), grant/revoke View+Share + effective grants feature.

GrantInput(user subject/level/effect/scope/permissions/expiry) без caller actor; allowed bits<=Permission::all(), scope/key validation. Actions signatures execute(OperationContext, *Input); RevokeGrantInput contains scoped node+grant identity, hard delete, foreign grant → node_not_found. Enumerable-role guard использует SELECTED profile driver.

Share list/create/revoke требуют View+Share и effective shareLinks. Commenter либо Comment raw permissions у anonymous share reject до mint; token storage hash/prefix only, plaintext only result. RevokeShareInput membership same located node, hard-delete/active revocation existing schema semantics preserve. Create validation в action/invariant, не только FormRequest.

Activity.forNode View guard; forDrive root View + target visibility каждого события на момент чтения. Filter in SQL by authoritative grant path или bounded exact candidate scan с CursorPaginator stable created_at DESC,id DESC; fill until page/budget, no total hidden nodes. Unknown/deleted target скрыт для user; drive-target events видны при root View; explicit system допускает все same drive records. Historical payload не заменяет current permission.

Migrate GrantController, NodeShareController, ActivityController и Filament NodeGrant/NodeShare/Activity read/write entry boundaries на core Operations (без нового DriveHandle: строят OperationContext из request/PanelActor и scoped drive, P3.3 заменяет builder на Vaulter::drive). Existing resource/filter/queryString adapted, no direct Action/Repository imports в этих migrated controllers/actions. Core operations работают без vaulter-drive binding для already-resolved drive.

ShareResolver public download existing defenses TTL/password/rate/server IP/scope/trashed/revoke сохраняются; add scan hook accepts current not_required before P3.7 implementation. Race revoke linearization explicit в invariant model, 404 после commit. Events получают context ActorRef/correlation, one row per event.

C04 operation feature matrix and C08 share live auth/derived tenant boundary; scan hook implemented P3.7, no claims bare legacy not_required is clean required-mode evidence.
